vlm_scores.reasoning: 1. Completeness: All expected objects (bed, 2 nightstands, wardrobe, dresser, rug) are present with no extras. 2. Spatial Reasonableness: Bed is against walls (good), nightstands are beside bed (good), but wardrobe/dresser lack wall placement and rug is not beside bed (poor). 3. No Collisions: Dresser and rug overlap significantly (critical issue). 4. Walkability: Narrow paths (e.g., 0.5m between bed and nightstands) and rug blocking space reduce usability. 5. Functional Layout: Nightstands beside bed works, but rug placement and wall placement for wardrobe/dresser fail. 6. Wall Utilization: Only bed is against walls; wardrobe/dresser are interior. 7. Overall Quality: Multiple critical failures (collisions, poor spatial placement) result in low usability.
